abilities.name: Big Sharp Teeth
abilities.text: Your mouth bristles with razor-sharp teeth. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d4 piercing damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group and have the finesse and [unarmed](/trait/unarmed) traits.

abilities.name: Darkvision
abilities.text: You can see in darkness and dim light just as well as you can see in bright light, though your vision in darkness is in black and white.

abilities.name: Wings
abilities.text: Your wings might not be as strong as other dragonets’, but can still prevent you from uncontrolled falls. You take no damage from falling, regardless of the distance you fall.
